feedback: can you make it so that the space inbetween the floors and ceilings are a bit larger, right now its hard to reliably jump over the red spikes, and can you also make sure that the red spikes don't spawn at the edge of the ledges, it makes it diffuclt to go through, we just need to make this a bit easier to play

selection.reason: Level generation parameters and logic are typically found in the prelude (constants) and resetGame/updatePhysics (spawning logic). Modifying these will allow us to increase the gap between floors/ceilings and prevent spikes from spawning on ledge edges.

patch.notes: Increased the vertical space between platform floors by changing the generation step from 3 to 4. Also updated the vertical dividers to cover the additional gap block so walls remain properly structured. Changed the spike spawn logic so that spikes no longer spawn on the tiles directly at the edges of the gaps, providing players more reliable footing before a jump.
